_readme: Sun Facing Checker launch support articles. Staged HTML lives in staged/insights/<slug>.html, same schema as the live production queue at ~/.claude/state/insights-drip/manifest.json (top level: articles[], drip_rate). These 3 entries continue that queue's ids (last live id was 1053, dates ran through 2026-09-17) at the next free dates, 1 per day. To actually schedule them, copy these 3 objects into the live manifest.json's articles array and copy the 3 files from staged/insights/ into the live staged/insights/ directory. This PR does not touch the live queue.

articles.title: Viewing a Unit at the Wrong Time of Day: Check the Sun First
articles.description: A single viewing at one hour hides afternoon west sun and shadow from neighbouring blocks. A checklist, and how to check the sun for any address before your next viewing.

articles.title: High Floor or Low Floor: What Sunlight and Shade Really Change
articles.description: Higher floor does not automatically mean more sun. How a neighbouring block's height and position shape sunlight and shade by storey, and how to check a specific stack.

articles.title: Renting in Singapore: Check Sun and Shade Before You Sign
articles.description: Laundry drying, a west facing bedroom, working from home glare, and kids' rooms: a tenant's checklist for sun and shade, plus a two minute check before you sign.
